newsitem.title: USA: Waigel-economic growth alone won't create jobs.
newsitem.headline: Waigel-economic growth alone won't create jobs.

text.p: German Finance Minister Theo Waigel said on Sunday that stronger economic growth alone will not solve Germany's unemployment problems and that structural hurdles stand in way of more German jobs.
Speaking at a news conference ahead of a meeting of Group Seven (G7) finance officials, Waigel said wage negotiations need to be made more flexible and pragmatic.
Waigel said his plans, fought by the opposition Social Democrats (SPD), to lower top tax rates would help make the economy more competitive and lead to job creation.
Although German unemployment stands at record high levels, Waigel said the overall economic environment is favourable with inflation and interest rates low and world trade increasing.

The number of German unemployed declined by 15,000 on a seasonally adjusted basis in March to 4.3 million, but most private economists expect it to remain near levels that this year have been the highest since World War Two.
